headline: US senator Lindsey Graham dies at 71

sources.title: Sen. Lindsey Graham of South Carolina, Trump ally and foreign policy hawk, dies at 71
Senator Lindsey Graham dies at 71 after 'brief and sudden illness'
Lindsey Graham died of aortic dissection, preliminary medical report says

chunks.text: The United States has lost one of its most familiar [[politicians]]. Lindsey Graham, a Republican [[senator]] from South Carolina, {{passed away}} on Saturday evening at the age of 71. In the days before, he had {{come down with}} a sudden illness, and his health {{went downhill}} very quickly. His family shared the news late that night and asked people to respect their [[privacy]].

verbs.correct: To die, in a gentle and polite way of saying it
verbs.wrong: To suddenly lose consciousness for a short time

verbs.correct: To start to have an illness that is not serious
verbs.wrong: To slowly develop a serious, long-lasting disease

verbs.correct: To get worse in health or condition over time
verbs.wrong: To become weak from a lack of food or rest

chunks.text: At first, doctors were not sure what had happened. Later, a medical examiner pointed to a problem called an aortic [[dissection]], which is a serious tear in the body's main blood [[vessel]]. This kind of illness can {{come on}} very fast and give almost no warning. Only two days earlier, Graham had {{flown back}} from a trip to Ukraine, where he had met the country's leader.

verbs.correct: To begin, especially an illness or a feeling

verbs.correct: To return to a place by plane

chunks.text: Graham had {{taken up}} politics many years earlier and had {{stayed on}} in public office ever since. He was first {{voted in}} to the Senate in 2002. Around the world, he was known for his strong [[views]] on war, peace, and foreign [[affairs]].

chunks.text: When the Senate returned to work, its members {{came together}} to mark his passing with a moment of silence. For that day, lawmakers {{set aside}} their usual [[differences]]. Many rose to {{look back}} on his long [[career]] and to honor his years of service.

tf.s: Lindsey Graham passed away on Saturday evening at the age of 71.
tf.why: The story says Graham passed away on Saturday evening at the age of 71.

tf.s: Doctors say Graham came down with a mild illness and soon made a full recovery.
tf.why: False. Graham came down with a serious illness and passed away; he did not recover.

tf.s: Graham had just flown back from a trip to Canada.
tf.why: Graham had flown back from a trip to Ukraine, not Canada.

tf.s: Graham was voted in to the Senate for the first time in 2002.
tf.why: The story says he was first voted in to the Senate in 2002.

tf.s: In the Senate, lawmakers set aside their differences to honor Graham.
tf.why: For that day, lawmakers set aside their usual differences to mark his passing.

tf.s: After the news, senators carried on with normal business and ignored his death.
tf.why: The Senate came together for a moment of silence and looked back on his career, so they did not ignore his death.
